about: Our body sliders (tools/body/sliders.py): each a named combination of MakeHuman CC0 macros (offsets on the spec's own macros, MPFB evaluates them as its nonlinear blends) and targets (MPFB data/targets; a 'pair' [decr, incr] takes the slider's magnitude on the side of its sign; 'lr' lays the l- and r- target alike). A slider's value is clipped to its range; macros to 0..1. Spec: "sliders": {name: value}.

height.why: stature: MakeHuman's height macro (whole body, its own nonlinear blend); the head ring is held, so it lengthens her below the neck

leg_length.why: legs against torso, thigh and shin together (her height is mostly leg)

torso_length.why: the trunk's height between hips and shoulders

shoulder_width.why: the shoulders' span (the arms ride on it)

build.why: muscle: MakeHuman's muscle macro about the spec's (0.75: athletic)

bust_firmness.why: how the breast holds its shape (low: it hangs)

bust_set.why: the breasts' height on the chest

bust_spacing.why: how far apart they sit (the cleavage)

bust_point.why: the breast's projection to its point

underbust.why: the rib cage under the bust

arm_girth.why: the upper arm's girth (MakeHuman's deltoid, biceps and triceps flow kept)

heavy.why: thick-and-curvy, never obese (the owner's taste): mass to the hips, glutes and thighs, the waist barely, the belly held in

male.why: male build for NPCs later: MakeHuman's gender macro (its male blends; no genitals: the game's Steam rule)

bust_lift.why: OURS (5 Nov, the owner: 'perfect breasts ... very well done'): MakeHuman's cup grows the breast mostly DOWN (its full cup hangs into a deep flat shelf, the upper pole hollows; firmness +1 moves 8 mm, set is a 19 mm slide): the cup's own growth turned up toward forward (25 deg where it leans forward, 30 where it points straight down): the upper pole fills, the point comes forward and up, the lower pole rounds forward instead of hanging; smooth as the cup's target, 0 where the cup does not move; the volume rises (keep bust_size about 0.1 lower for the same size)

glute_lift.why: OURS (5 Nov, the owner: 'breast and butt are very important'): MakeHuman's buttock volume tops out at 22 mm and sits low: the buttock turns up about its root and fills at its core: full, round, high
